"""Health/readiness endpoints. No business logic.

/readyz performs live dependency checks (PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO) and returns
503 when any of them fails. Failure details contain no payloads — only the
exception class name and probe latency.
"""

import asyncio
import logging
import time
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel

from app import __version__
from app.config import get_settings
from app.infra.container import Dependencies

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter(tags=["health"])


class HealthStatus(BaseModel):
    status: str
    version: str


class ReadinessCheck(BaseModel):
    name: str
    status: str
    detail: str | None = None


class ReadinessStatus(BaseModel):
    status: str
    version: str
    checks: list[ReadinessCheck]


@router.get("/healthz", response_model=HealthStatus)
async def healthz() -> HealthStatus:
    """Liveness: the API process is up."""
    return HealthStatus(status="ok", version=__version__)


async def _run_check(
    name: str,
    probe: Callable[[], Awaitable[None]],
    timeout_seconds: float,
) -> ReadinessCheck:
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        async with asyncio.timeout(timeout_seconds):
            await probe()
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("Readiness check failed: name=%s error=%s", name, type(exc).__name__)
        return ReadinessCheck(name=name, status="fail", detail=type(exc).__name__)
    elapsed_ms = int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000)
    return ReadinessCheck(name=name, status="ok", detail=f"{elapsed_ms}ms")


@router.get("/readyz", response_model=ReadinessStatus)
async def readyz(request: Request) -> JSONResponse:
    """Readiness: configuration plus live PostgreSQL/Redis/MinIO checks."""
    deps: Dependencies = request.app.state.deps
    settings = get_settings()
    timeout = settings.readiness_timeout_seconds

    checks = list(
        await asyncio.gather(
            _run_check("postgres", deps.db.health_check, timeout),
            _run_check("redis", deps.redis.health_check, timeout),
            _run_check("minio", deps.minio.health_check, timeout),
        )
    )
    degraded = any(check.status == "fail" for check in checks)
    body = ReadinessStatus(
        status="degraded" if degraded else "ok",
        version=__version__,
        checks=checks,
    )
    return JSONResponse(status_code=503 if degraded else 200, content=body.model_dump())

"""Secret masking for logs (AGENTS.md §6: never log tokens/passwords/secrets).

Pattern-based masking is applied to every log message before serialization.
It is a defense-in-depth measure; code must still avoid putting secrets into
log messages in the first place.
"""

import re

_SECRET_PATTERNS = [
    # Authorization: Bearer <token> / Authorization: Basic ...
    re.compile(r"(?i)(authorization\s*:\s*(?:bearer|basic)\s+)\S+"),
    # password=... / token: ... / api_key=... etc.
    re.compile(
        r"(?i)((?:password|passwd|secret|token|api[_-]?key|access[_-]?key)\s*[=:]\s+)\S+"
    ),
]


def mask_secrets(text: str) -> str:
    for pattern in _SECRET_PATTERNS:
        text = pattern.sub(r"\1***", text)
    return text

"""JSON logging with correlation ID and secret masking.

Full structured logging policy (field allowlist, request bodies) lands later;
this module owns the format every component reuses.
"""

import json
import logging
import time
from contextvars import ContextVar
from typing import Any

from app.secrets_masking import mask_secrets

correlation_id_var: ContextVar[str] = ContextVar("correlation_id", default="-")


class JsonFormatter(logging.Formatter):
    def format(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> str:
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            "ts": time.strftime(
                "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z", time.localtime(record.created)
            ),
            "level": record.levelname,
            "logger": record.name,
            "message": mask_secrets(record.getMessage()),
            "correlation_id": correlation_id_var.get(),
        }
        if record.exc_info:
            payload["exc_info"] = self.formatException(record.exc_info)
        return json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)


def configure_logging(level: str) -> None:
    handler = logging.StreamHandler()
    handler.setFormatter(JsonFormatter())
    root = logging.getLogger()
    root.handlers = [handler]
    root.setLevel(level)

from typing import Any


class FakeProbe:
    """Stands in for any infra client; may be told to raise."""

    def __init__(self, fail: bool = False, delay_seconds: float = 0.0) -> None:
        self.fail = fail
        self.delay_seconds = delay_seconds
        self.closed = False
        self.calls = 0

    async def health_check(self) -> None:
        self.calls += 1
        if self.delay_seconds:
            import asyncio

            await asyncio.sleep(self.delay_seconds)
        if self.fail:
            raise ConnectionError("fake down")

    async def close(self) -> None:
        self.closed = True

"""ARQ feasibility spike (decision D-030, status PROPOSED).

Verifies that arq imports cleanly, a worker can be constructed, and — when a
Redis is reachable at 127.0.0.1:6379 — that a task round-trips through a live
worker: enqueue -> execute -> result.

Run: python spikes/arq_spike.py
"""

import asyncio
import logging
from importlib.metadata import version

from arq.connections import RedisSettings

logging.disable(logging.CRITICAL)


async def dummy_task(ctx: dict[str, object]) -> str:
    return "arq-round-trip-ok"


class SpikeWorkerSettings:
    functions = [dummy_task]
    redis_settings = RedisSettings(host="127.0.0.1", port=6379)


async def round_trip() -> bool:
    """Enqueue a task and get the result back through a live worker, if Redis is up."""
    from arq import create_pool
    from arq.worker import create_worker

    try:
        pool = await create_pool(SpikeWorkerSettings.redis_settings)
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"Redis unavailable, round-trip skipped: {type(exc).__name__}")
        return False

    worker = create_worker(SpikeWorkerSettings)
    if not hasattr(worker, "async_run"):
        print("arq API changed: Worker.async_run is missing; round-trip skipped")
        return False

    runner = asyncio.create_task(worker.async_run())
    try:
        job = await pool.enqueue_task("dummy_task")
        result = await job.result(timeout=10)
        print(f"ARQ round-trip result: {result}")
        return result == "arq-round-trip-ok"
    finally:
        await worker.async_stop()
        runner.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(runner, return_exceptions=True)


def main() -> None:
    import arq

    worker_check = create_worker(SpikeWorkerSettings)
    print(f"arq {arq.VERSION} imported OK")  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    print(f"asyncpg {version('asyncpg')} OK")
    print(f"worker constructed OK: {type(worker_check).__name__}")
    completed = asyncio.run(round_trip())
    print("Round-trip verified." if completed else "Round-trip NOT verified.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Alembic environment (async). URL: DATABASE_URL env var, else app settings."""

import asyncio
import os
from logging.config import fileConfig

from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import pool
from sqlalchemy.engine import Connection
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import async_engine_from_config

from app.config import get_settings
from app.models import Base

config = context.config

if config.config_file_name is not None:
    fileConfig(config.config_file_name)

target_metadata = Base.metadata


def _database_url() -> str:
    url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
    if url:
        return url
    return get_settings().database_url


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    context.configure(
        url=_database_url(),
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
        compare_type=True,
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def do_run_migrations(connection: Connection) -> None:
    context.configure(
        connection=connection,
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        compare_type=True,
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


async def run_async_migrations() -> None:
    connectable = async_engine_from_config(
        {"sqlalchemy.url": _database_url()},
        prefix="sqlalchemy.",
        poolclass=pool.NullPool,
    )
    async with connectable.connect() as connection:
        await connection.run_sync(do_run_migrations)
    await connectable.dispose()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    asyncio.run(run_async_migrations())


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()

"""Migration tests: real PostgreSQL, upgrade and downgrade paths."""

import asyncio
from pathlib import Path

from alembic import command
from alembic.config import Config
from sqlalchemy import inspect
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine

from tests.conftest import BACKEND_DIR

EXPECTED_TABLES = {
    "users",
    "channels",
    "user_identities",
    "corporate_accounts",
    "conversations",
    "conversation_sessions",
    "tickets",
    "messages",
}


def test_upgrade_creates_all_first_group_tables(test_db_url: str) -> None:
    async def check() -> set[str]:
        engine = create_async_engine(test_db_url)
        try:
            async with engine.connect() as connection:
                inspector = inspect(await connection.connection())
                tables = set(inspector.get_table_names())
            return tables
        finally:
            await engine.dispose()

    tables = asyncio.run(check())
    assert EXPECTED_TABLES.issubset(tables)


def test_downgrade_then_upgrade_roundtrip(test_db_url: str) -> None:
    config = Config(str(BACKEND_DIR / "alembic.ini"))
    config.set_main_option("script_location", str(BACKEND_DIR / "alembic"))

    command.downgrade(config, "base")

    async def tables_after_downgrade() -> set[str]:
        engine = create_async_engine(test_db_url)
        try:
            async with engine.connect() as connection:
                inspector = inspect(await connection.connection())
                return set(inspector.get_table_names())
        finally:
            await engine.dispose()

    assert EXPECTED_TABLES.isdisjoint(asyncio.run(tables_after_downgrade()))

    command.upgrade(config, "head")
    assert EXPECTED_TABLES.issubset(asyncio.run(tables_after_downgrade()))

"""Concurrent sequence allocation on real PostgreSQL.

Stage 4 will move allocation into MessageService; these tests pin the DB-level
guarantees it must rely on.
"""

import pytest
from sqlalchemy import insert, text
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncEngine, create_async_engine

from app.models import Message

from tests.helpers import seed_conversation


@pytest.fixture
async def engine(test_db_url: str):
    eng = create_async_engine(test_db_url)
    yield eng
    await eng.dispose()

    return await seed_conversation(engine)


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_row_lock_allocates_distinct_sequences(
    engine: AsyncEngine, seeded
) -> None:
    """Two concurrent writers get distinct sequence numbers via row lock."""
    import uuid

    conversation_id, user_id = seeded

    async def writer() -> int:
        async with engine.begin() as conn:
            result = await conn.execute(
                text(
                    "UPDATE conversations SET last_message_sequence = last_message_sequence + 1 "
                    "WHERE id = :cid RETURNING last_message_sequence"
                ),
                {"cid": conversation_id},
            )
            sequence = result.scalar_one()
            await conn.execute(
                insert(Message).values(
                    conversation_id=conversation_id,
                    sequence_no=sequence,
                    author_type="USER",
                    author_user_id=user_id,
                    text=f"concurrent-{sequence}",
                )
            )
            return sequence

    sequences = sorted(await asyncio.gather(writer(), writer()))
    assert sequences == [1, 2]


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_unique_index_blocks_racing_plain_reads(
    engine: AsyncEngine, seeded
) -> None:
    """Read-then-insert without locking: exactly one writer wins, one fails."""
    import uuid

    conversation_id, user_id = seeded

    async def racer(conn) -> None:
        await conn.execute(
            text("SELECT last_message_sequence FROM conversations WHERE id = :cid"),
            {"cid": conversation_id},
        )
        await conn.execute(
            insert(Message).values(
                conversation_id=conversation_id,
                sequence_no=1,
                author_type="USER",
                author_user_id=user_id,
                text="race",
            )
        )

    conn1 = await engine.connect()
    conn2 = await engine.connect()
    results: list[BaseException | None] = [None, None]

    async def run(conn, slot: int) -> None:
        try:
            async with conn.begin():
                await racer(conn)
        except BaseException as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - test collects everything
            results[slot] = exc

    await asyncio.gather(run(conn1, 0), run(conn2, 1))

@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_row_lock_allocates_distinct_sequences(
    test_db_url: str, conversation_id
) -> None:
    """Two concurrent writers get distinct sequence numbers via row lock."""
    conversation, user_id = conversation_id
    engine = create_async_engine(test_db_url)

    async def writer() -> int:
        async with engine.begin() as conn:
            result = await conn.execute(
                text(
                    "UPDATE conversations SET last_message_sequence = last_message_sequence + 1 "
                    "WHERE id = :cid RETURNING last_message_sequence"
                ),
                {"cid": conversation},
            )
            sequence = result.scalar_one()
            await conn.execute(
                insert(Message).values(
                    conversation_id=conversation,
                    sequence_no=sequence,
                    author_type="USER",
                    author_user_id=user_id,
                    text=f"concurrent-{sequence}",
                )
            )
            return sequence

    try:
        sequences = sorted(await asyncio.gather(writer(), writer()))
    finally:
        await engine.dispose()

    assert sequences == [1, 2]


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_unique_index_blocks_racing_plain_reads(
    test_db_url: str, conversation_id
) -> None:
    """Read-then-insert without locking: exactly one writer wins, one fails."""
    conversation, user_id = conversation_id
    engine = create_async_engine(test_db_url)

    async def racer(conn) -> None:
        await conn.execute(
            text("SELECT last_message_sequence FROM conversations WHERE id = :cid"),
            {"cid": conversation},
        )
        await conn.execute(
            insert(Message).values(
                conversation_id=conversation,
                sequence_no=1,
                author_type="USER",
                author_user_id=user_id,
                text="race",
            )
        )

    async def run(slot: int, results: list[BaseException | None]) -> None:
        conn = await engine.connect()
        try:
            async with conn.begin():
                await racer(conn)
        except BaseException as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - test collects everything
            results[slot] = exc
        finally:
            await conn.close()

    results: list[BaseException | None] = [None, None]
    try:
        await asyncio.gather(run(0, results), run(1, results))
    finally:
        await engine.dispose()

    outcomes = [type(r).__name__ if r is not None else "ok" for r in results]
    assert sorted(outcomes) == ["IntegrityError", "ok"], outcomes

I decided earlier about native enums — but let me reconsider quickly: I've already got String(20) columns + CHECK value constraints in the migration, and StrEnum in models. The mismatch issue: Mapped[DialogMode] with String(20) column type — SQLAlchemy 2 will use String type; writes: enum value is str (StrEnum) → stored fine; reads: plain str, not DialogMode. The service layer (stage 4) can convert, or I use explicit Enum(native_enum=False, length=20) which wraps with varchar+CHECK automatically and returns enum members.

Given "Проверки переходов статусов должны быть в доменном сервисе" and SQLAlchemy 2 typed mappings best practice (docs/09: "SQLAlchemy 2 typed mappings"), typed enums on read are valuable. Switch to sa.Enum(native_enum=False, length=20) — renders VARCHAR(20) + CHECK, no PG type, returns enum members. Then in migration use sa.Enum(..., native_enum=False, length=20) too (renders same VARCHAR + auto CHECK) — actually in alembic migration, sa.Enum(DialogMode, native_enum=False, length=20) creates VARCHAR(20) + CHECK constraint named ck_..._follows sqlalchemy naming? It creates a CHECK constraint with autogenerated name. My hand-written migration has explicit named CHECKs — I'll keep String(20) + explicit CHECK in migration and switch models to sa.Enum(native_enum=False). Autogenerate diff would show CHECK name differences — acceptable noise? Autogenerate runs model-vs-DB compare; CHECK constraint compare: Alembic 1.12+ compares CHECK constraints — would flag names. Meh.

Cleaner: use sa.Enum(native_enum=False) in BOTH model and migration; alembic will emit VARCHAR(20) + CHECK (auto-named). Drop my hand-named status CHECKs from migration. The auto-generated CHECK names are deterministic (e.g. ck_conversations_mode_...). Fine.

Hmm, wait — does sa.Enum(native_enum=False, length=20) also emit a constraint on create_table in Alembic? Yes, it renders VARCHAR(20) and attaches a CHECK via the type's create constraints (schema.CheckConstraint added when table created with that type). Standard SQLAlchemy create_table adds the CHECK automatically. Same in Alembic op.create_table. OK.

Simplify model changes:
- mode: Mapped[DialogMode] = mapped_column(sa.Enum(DialogMode, native_enum=False, length=20), nullable=False, default=DialogMode.AI_ACTIVE) — remove explicit String(20) and remove ck_conversation_mode.
Same for others. Migration: sa.Column("mode", sa.Enum(DialogMode, native_enum=False, length=20, values_callable=...), server_default="AI_ACTIVE").

values_callable for StrEnum: Enum type stores .value by default? sa.Enum uses member *names* as DB values by default? No — sa.Enum uses the *values* (the strings) — actually SQLAlchemy Enum default uses the .name? Docs: "Above, the string names of the members, e.g. 'one', 'two' or 'three', are persisted" — that's for class with names... SQLAlchemy stores the .name by default? Let me recall precisely: SQLAlchemy Enum(PyEnumClass) persists **.name** by default? No — it persists member *values*? From docs: "When using an enumerated class, the enumerated objects are used both for input and output, rather than strings... the string values are persisted; by default, the *names* are used"? 

Ugh — exact rule: SQLAlchemy Enum defaults to storing the **values** of the enum? The docs say: "The Enum type, when used with a Python enum class, persists the .name of members by default." I believe default behavior: it uses the member NAME (e.g. "PENDING_USER")... our members are named exactly like their values (NEW='NEW'), so name==value for all my enums! Every member: AI_ACTIVE='AI_ACTIVE' etc. So name==value — no distinction.

- **8 таблиц** по `docs/03` (`users`, `user_identities`, `corporate_accounts`, `channels`, `conversations`, `conversation_sessions`, `tickets`, `messages`) — `backend/app/models/` (SQLAlchemy 2 typed mappings, UUID PK, TIMESTAMPTZ UTC).

## Objective
- Перевести проект Support Hub (замена CraftTalk: приём сообщений из мессенджера Tag через существующего Mattermost-бота, полная история, AI Orchestrator, рабочее место оператора) из стадии проектирования в реализацию поэтапно: аудит → документация плана → этапы bootstrap/инфраструктуры/БД → далее доменные сервисы. Работать на русском, поэтапно, с отчётами и подтверждением владельца между этапами.

## Requirements
- Git не используется и не будет; версионирование/перенос в корпоративную сеть — средствами владельца (D-035).
- Проект пишется в корне `C:\Opencode\Support Hub`; разворачиваться будет в другой корпоративной сети — владелец сам адаптирует под неё (D-036/D-037); `support-hub-opencode-pack/` остаётся вложенным пакетом контекста без изменений.
- Ключевое правило: одно обращение = один тикет = один логический диалог; не дробить (D-005). Сессия — ровно 3 часа (D-007); Handoff безвозвратен в MVP (D-014); полная история в Support Hub (D-015); заметки отдельны (D-025).
- Не выдумывать контракты Tag/бота/AI Orchestrator; предложенные в docs/04/05/13 endpoints — проектные эскизы.
- Не запускать реализацию всего сразу; после этапов — отчёт и ожидание подтверждения; не заявлять о проверках, которые реально не выполнены.
- Ответы пользователя на последние вопросы: MinIO локально не нужен («здесь мы пишем по сути основу, а потом я адаптирую под корпоративную систему»); удалить MinIO из локального стека; переходить к этапу 4.

## Decisions
- Решения владельца зафиксированы в `docs/12_DECISION_LOG.md`: D-035 (без Git), D-036 (разработка здесь, деплой в корп сети), D-037 (корень = рабочий каталог).
- Стек: FastAPI/SQLAlchemy 2.x async/Alembic/PostgreSQL 16/Redis 7/ARQ (спайк пройден полностью), React+TS (Vite), единый error envelope `{"error":{code,message,details},"correlation_id"}`, JSON-логи с маскированием секретов.
- Модель: UUID PK, статусы — StrEnum + `sa.Enum(native_enum=False)` (VARCHAR+CHECK), составные FK `(conversation_id,user_id)` и reply-in-same-conversation, partial UNIQUE одна ACTIVE-сессия, CHECK «expires_at = started_at + 3 hours».
- Каталог миграций — `backend/migrations/` (не `alembic/`: затенял пакет alembic).
- MinIO: убирается из локального docker-compose и из `/readyz` (вложения — этап 5; клиент-заготовка `app/infra/minio_client.py` остаётся); в корп сети хранилище подставит инфраструктура. Публичные образы MinIO недоступны (Docker Hub удалён, quay приватен, dl.min.io недоступен).
- URL локальных сервисов — `127.0.0.1` (не `localhost`: IPv6-резолв давал 2.1 с и ложные таймауты); `readiness_timeout_seconds` default 5.0.

## Work State
### Completed
- Этап 0: аудит + 4 документа в `docs/implementation/` (REPOSITORY_AUDIT, ARCHITECTURE_GAPS G-01…G-13/R-01…R-06, IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN 10 этапов, TECH_DECISIONS P-01…P-13/Q-01…Q-13).

### Blocked
- (none) — MinIO больше не блокирует; контракты бота/AI Orchestrator (Q-06–Q-08) нужны на этапах 5–6, не сейчас.

## Next Move
1. Дозакрыть удаление MinIO из кода/тестов (container.py, health.py, fakes.py, test_health.py, test_readyz.py), обновить README, прогнать pytest.

4. Отчёт владельцу: ответы на «3 вопроса» (G-03, G-06/P-04, G-13/P-06) с использованными PROPOSED-допущениями; не переходить к этапу 5 без подтверждения.

## Relevant Files

- `support-hub-opencode-pack/docs/implementation/TECH_DECISIONS.md` — P-01…P-13, Q-01…Q-13, обновления D-030
- `support-hub-opencode-pack/docs/12_DECISION_LOG.md` — журнал решений D-001…D-037

- `backend/app/api/health.py` — `/readyz` (требует правки: убрать minio-проверку)

- `deploy/docker-compose.yml` — локальный стек (postgres+redis; minio уже удалён)
- `backend/pyproject.toml` — зависимости (alembic, arq в dev; из el). `backend/spikes/arq_spike.py` — проверенный спайк ARQ

59:         return ReadinessCheck(name=name, status="fail", detail=type(exc).__name__)
60:     elapsed_ms = int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000)
61:     return ReadinessCheck(name=name, status="ok", detail=f"{elapsed_ms}ms")

"""Runtime dependency container.

Built once at app creation (connections are lazy), closed on lifespan shutdown.
Object storage is NOT a local dependency: attachments arrive at stage 5 and the
corporate network provides its own storage (see deploy/docker-compose.yml).
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass

from app.config import Settings
from app.infra.db import DatabaseClient
from app.infra.redis_client import RedisClient


@dataclass
class Dependencies:
    db: DatabaseClient
    redis: RedisClient

    async def close(self) -> None:
        await self.db.close()
        await self.redis.close()


def build_dependencies(settings: Settings) -> Dependencies:
    return Dependencies(
        db=DatabaseClient(settings.database_url),
        redis=RedisClient(settings.redis_url),
    )

"""Readiness aggregation tests: healthy, degraded, timeout, shutdown closing."""

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.main import create_app
from tests.fakes import FakeProbe, make_deps


def test_readyz_503_when_postgres_down() -> None:
    client = TestClient(create_app(deps=make_deps(db_fail=True)))
    response = client.get("/readyz")

    assert response.status_code == 503
    body = response.json()
    assert body["status"] == "degraded"
    postgres_check = next(c for c in body["checks"] if c["name"] == "postgres")
    assert postgres_check["status"] == "fail"
    assert postgres_check["detail"] == "ConnectionError"
    assert {c["name"] for c in body["checks"]} == {"postgres", "redis"}


def test_readyz_503_when_redis_down() -> None:
    client = TestClient(create_app(deps=make_deps(redis_fail=True)))

    assert client.get("/readyz").status_code == 503


def test_readyz_fail_on_probe_timeout() -> None:
    deps = make_deps()
    deps.redis = FakeProbe(delay_seconds=6.0)  # exceeds readiness timeout (5s default)
    client = TestClient(create_app(deps=deps))
    response = client.get("/readyz")

    assert response.status_code == 503
    redis_check = next(c for c in response.json()["checks"] if c["name"] == "redis")
    assert redis_check["status"] == "fail"
    assert redis_check["detail"] == "TimeoutError"


def test_shutdown_closes_dependencies() -> None:
    deps = make_deps()
    with TestClient(create_app(deps=deps)):
        pass  # lifespan starts on enter, shutdown runs on exit

    assert deps.db.closed
    assert deps.redis.closed

# Support Hub — инструкции для OpenCode

## 1. Роль и язык

Ты — ведущий архитектор и senior full-stack инженер проекта Support Hub. Работай как coding-agent: исследуй репозиторий, планируй, реализуй небольшими проверяемыми шагами, тестируй и документируй.

- Общайся с владельцем проекта на русском языке.
- Имена классов, функций, переменных, API-полей и программные комментарии используй на английском, если нет причины иначе.
- Объясняй архитектурные решения простым техническим языком.
- Не заявляй, что код, миграция, тест или интеграция работают, пока это не проверено выполнением.

## 2. Обязательный контекст

Перед существенной работой изучи:

1. `README.md`;
2. `docs/00_PROJECT_BRIEF.md`;
3. `docs/01_BUSINESS_RULES.md`;
4. `docs/02_ARCHITECTURE.md`;
5. релевантные документы в `docs/`;
6. существующий код и конфигурацию репозитория.

Не загружай все документы бездумно для каждой мелкой задачи; используй их по релевантности. При начале проекта прочитай весь каталог `docs/` и сформируй краткую карту контекста.

## 3. Непереговорные продуктовые правила

- **Одно обращение пользователя = один тикет = один логический диалог.** Не предлагай дробить одно обращение на несколько тикетов. Несколько проблем в одном обращении остаются в одном тикете.
- Один тикет связан с одним логическим диалогом; у диалога может быть несколько трёхчасовых сессий.
- Сессия длится ровно 3 часа от создания. Это не idle timeout и активность не продлевает её.
- Истечение сессии не закрывает тикет и не закрывает диалог.
- После `CLOSED` следующее обращение начинает новый тикет и новый диалог.
- Продолжение той же проблемы после `RESOLVED` возвращает прежний тикет в `OPEN`.
- После ответа оператора тикет переходит в `PENDING_USER`; после нового сообщения пользователя — в `OPEN`.
- SLA продолжает отсчитываться в `PENDING_USER`.
- После Human Handoff ИИ больше не обрабатывает новые сообщения этого диалога в MVP. Автоматического возврата к ИИ нет.
- Support Hub — источник истины и владелец полной истории сообщений. AI Orchestrator не является владельцем истории.
- Mattermost Bot сохраняется как транспортный адаптер. Не заменяй его без отдельного решения.
- RAG, Pre-process, Post-process и AI Orchestrator остаются отдельной существующей внутренней разработкой. Не переносить их внутрь Support Hub.
- Внутренние заметки операторов не являются публичными сообщениями и не отправляются пользователю или ИИ автоматически.

## 4. Архитектурные ограничения

- Архитектура: модульный монолит, не набор микросервисов.
- Backend: Python + FastAPI.
- БД: PostgreSQL.
- ORM: SQLAlchemy 2.x; миграции Alembic.
- Схемы и валидация: Pydantic v2.
- Redis для временного состояния/присутствия/координации и очередей согласно выбранной реализации.
- Фоновые задачи: worker; ARQ — предпочтительный кандидат, но окончательный выбор нужно проверить и зафиксировать.
- Frontend: React + TypeScript.
- Файлы: MinIO.
- Авторизация операторов: Keycloak OIDC через корпоративный LDAP/AD.
- On-premise развертывание; Docker Compose для MVP, Nginx как reverse proxy.
- Tag — корпоративный мессенджер на базе Mattermost.

Не добавляй Kafka, Kubernetes, микросервисы, отдельные базы для каждого модуля или другие тяжёлые компоненты без обоснованной необходимости и согласования.

## 5. Интеграции

### Tag / Mattermost

- Tag присылает сообщения на webhook callback существующего бота.
- Текущий payload содержит `team_id`, `team_domain`, `channel_id`, `channel_name`, `timestamp`, `user_id`, `user_name`, `post_id`, `text`, `file_ids`.
- Бот принимает callback и передаёт нормализованное событие в Support Hub.
- Исходящие ответы Support Hub возвращаются через существующего бота, который использует свою текущую реализацию отправки в Tag.
- Токен Tag принадлежит существующему боту; не переносить его в Support Hub без отдельного согласования.
- Первый пример с алертами из другого проекта (fire-and-forget, `@all`, timeout 5 секунд, редактирование алертов) не является требованиями Support Hub.
- Tag Bot Webhook API — корпоративное расширение, описанное пользователем. Не утверждай, что это стандартная функция Mattermost.
- Стандартные Mattermost endpoints для постов/файлов можно использовать только после проверки прав, версии и особенностей инсталляции Tag.
- Не предполагай callback authentication, retry semantics или timestamp units: они остаются открытыми вопросами.
- Фильтруй собственные сообщения бота и системные события, чтобы не создавать циклы; точные поля payload надо подтвердить.

### AI Orchestrator

- Предлагавшиеся endpoints и JSON-контракты являются проектными, не подтверждёнными существующими API.
- Перед реальной интеграцией исследуй текущий контракт Orchestrator и сделай адаптер.
- Support Hub передаёт текущий запрос и необходимую историю, сформированную из собственной БД.
- Оркестратор возвращает ответ, Human Handoff или техническую ошибку.
- Проверяй режим и версию состояния диалога при приёме результата.

## 6. Инженерные требования

- Сначала осматривай существующий репозиторий. Не перезаписывай его файлы без проверки.
- Не создавай огромный объём кода за один проход. Разбивай работу на маленькие вертикальные этапы.
- Сначала предложи план и критерии приёмки; затем реализуй согласованный этап.
- Используй типизацию, явные схемы, dependency injection и разделение API / services / repositories.
- Не помещай бизнес-логику в FastAPI route handlers.
- Все изменения схемы БД — через Alembic. Не используй `create_all()` как production-миграции.
- Не используй SQLite как замену PostgreSQL для проверки специфичных ограничений, ENUM, JSONB, partial indexes и конкурентных транзакций.
- Тестируй реальные ограничения PostgreSQL и конкурентные сценарии.
- Для исходящих сообщений используй транзакционный Outbox. Понимай, что сеть даёт at-least-once, а не магическое exactly-once; проектируй идемпотентность и сверку неопределённых результатов.
- Входящие webhook должны быть идемпотентны по внешнему ID события.
- Используй `Decimal` для денежных значений, если они появятся; не используй float для точных величин.
- Храни время в UTC (`TIMESTAMPTZ`), отображай с учётом настроенного timezone.
- Не логируй токены, пароли, полные секретные payload, содержимое файлов или лишние персональные данные.
- Проверяй авторизацию на backend для каждого endpoint. Скрытие кнопки во frontend не является защитой.
- Не открывай MinIO публично; выдавай контролируемый доступ к файлам.
- Все важные действия оператора должны попадать в аудит.

## 7. Проверки

После изменений запускай применимые проверки и сообщай точные результаты:

- Backend: pytest, Ruff, mypy/Pyright (после появления конфигурации).
- Frontend: lint, typecheck, tests, build (после появления конфигурации).
- DB: Alembic upgrade/downgrade на тестовой PostgreSQL, проверка индексов/FK.
- Integrations: тесты на idempotency, retry, timeout, duplicate callbacks и stale AI responses.

Не утверждай, что проверки пройдены, если команды не запускались.

## 8. Работа с неопределённостью

- Не придумывай контракт Tag или AI Orchestrator.
- Не трактуй проектные примеры JSON как реальные контракты внешних систем.
- Не превращай открытые вопросы в тихие допущения.
- Если неизвестное не блокирует задачу, запиши допущение в `docs/DECISIONS.md` с пометкой `PROPOSED`.
- Если неизвестное влияет на безопасность, целостность данных, миграцию или внешний контракт — остановись и запроси решение.
- При обнаружении противоречий между документами сообщи об этом и предложи исправление; не выбирай вариант молча.

## 9. Процесс начала нового этапа

1. Скажи, какие документы и файлы изучены.
2. Проверь текущее состояние репозитория и `git status`.
3. Сформулируй задачу, границы этапа и критерии приёмки.
4. Перечисли допущения и блокирующие вопросы.
5. Предложи минимальный план.
6. После согласования выполняй этап.
7. Запусти тесты и покажи изменённые файлы.
8. Обнови документацию при изменении архитектурных решений.

Не начинай с генерации всего приложения целиком.

"""Integration tables: transactional outbox and inbound event dedup (docs/03 #13/#14)."""

import enum
import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import (
    BigInteger,
    CheckConstraint,
    DateTime,
    Enum,
    ForeignKey,
    Index,
    String,
    Text,
    UniqueConstraint,
    text,
)
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import JSONB, UUID
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from app.models.base import Base, TimestampMixin, UuidPkMixin


class OutboxStatus(enum.StrEnum):
    NEW = "NEW"
    PROCESSING = "PROCESSING"
    PROCESSED = "PROCESSED"


class IntegrationEventStatus(enum.StrEnum):
    RECEIVED = "RECEIVED"
    PROCESSED = "PROCESSED"


class OutboxEvent(UuidPkMixin, TimestampMixin, Base):
    """Transactional outbox: written in the same transaction as the business change.

    A worker leases rows (SKIP LOCKED), dispatches them and marks them processed.
    Delivery to consumers is at-least-once: consumers dedup by idempotency_key.
    """

    __tablename__ = "outbox_events"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("idempotency_key", name="uq_outbox_idempotency_key"),
        CheckConstraint("attempts >= 0", name="ck_outbox_attempts"),
        # Pending rows ordered by next dispatch time (NULL = immediately).
        Index(
            "ix_outbox_pending",
            "next_attempt_at",
            postgresql_where=text("status IN ('NEW', 'PROCESSING')"),
        ),
    )

    event_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100), nullable=False)
    aggregate_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=False)
    aggregate_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(
        UUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=True
    )
    idempotency_key: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    payload: Mapped[dict[str, Any]] = mapped_column(JSONB, nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[OutboxStatus] = mapped_column(
        Enum(OutboxStatus, native_enum=False, length=20),
        nullable=False,
        default=OutboxStatus.NEW,
    )
    attempts: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False, default=0)
    lease_expires_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True
    )
    next_attempt_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True
    )
    last_error: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    processed_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True
    )


class IntegrationEvent(UuidPkMixin, Base):
    """Inbound webhook dedup: UNIQUE (source, external_event_id) (docs/03 §3).

    Stage 5 registers every normalized Tag event here before processing.
    """

    __tablename__ = "integration_events"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("source", "external_event_id", name="uq_integration_event"),
        CheckConstraint(
            "status IN ('RECEIVED', 'PROCESSED')", name="ck_integration_event_status"
        ),
    )

    source: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=False)
    external_event_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[IntegrationEventStatus] = mapped_column(
        Enum(IntegrationEventStatus, native_enum=False, length=20),
        nullable=False,
        default=IntegrationEventStatus.RECEIVED,
    )
    payload: Mapped[dict[str, Any] | None] = mapped_column(JSONB, nullable=True)
    received_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, server_default=text("now()")
    )
    processed_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True
    )

    OPERATOR_CLOSED = "OPERATOR_CLOSED"


# Target status per trigger, or None = status unchanged.
_TICKET_TARGET: dict[TicketTrigger, object] = {
    TicketTrigger.USER_MESSAGE: "OPEN",
    TicketTrigger.AI_REPLY: "OPEN",
    TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_REPLY: "PENDING_USER",
    TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_RESOLVED: "RESOLVED",
    TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_CLOSED: "CLOSED",
}

# From which ticket statuses each trigger is accepted. CLOSED is terminal for
# every trigger; a message after CLOSED creates a new ticket (routing, P-04).
_TICKET_ALLOWED_SOURCES: dict[TicketTrigger, frozenset[str]] = {
    # User's own message: reopen/reply semantics (D-010). NEW stays NEW until
    # the first answer — that is the PROPOSED P-14/G-03 reading.
    TicketTrigger.USER_MESSAGE: frozenset({"OPEN", "PENDING_USER", "RESOLVED"}),
    # PROPOSED P-14: first AI reply opens the ticket; AI never answers a
    # PENDING_USER/RESOLVED ticket (dialog would be in human mode).
    TicketTrigger.AI_REPLY: frozenset({"NEW", "OPEN"}),
    # Operator reply straight to PENDING_USER (D-011); answering a RESOLVED
    # ticket means work continues — same target (PROPOSED, part of P-14).
    TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_REPLY: frozenset(
        {"NEW", "OPEN", "PENDING_USER", "RESOLVED"}
    ),
    TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_RESOLVED: frozenset({"NEW", "OPEN", "PENDING_USER"}),
    # The operator decides when to close (docs/01 §3); no auto-close exists.
    TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_CLOSED: frozenset(
        {"NEW", "OPEN", "PENDING_USER", "RESOLVED"}
    ),
}


def next_ticket_status(current: str, trigger: TicketTrigger) -> str:
    """Return the ticket status after the trigger; raises when forbidden."""
    target = _TICKET_TARGET[trigger]
    if current in _TICKET_ALLOWED_SOURCES[trigger]:
        return str(target)
    raise TransitionNotAllowed("ticket", current, str(target))


class DialogTrigger(StrEnum):
    HUMAN_HANDOFF = "HUMAN_HANDOFF"  # AI requested handoff (stage 6)
    OPERATOR_TOOK_OVER = "OPERATOR_TOOK_OVER"  # claim or first operator reply
    CONVERSATION_CLOSED = "CONVERSATION_CLOSED"


_DIALOG_ALLOWED: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {
    "AI_ACTIVE": frozenset({"HUMAN_PENDING", "HUMAN_ACTIVE", "CLOSED"}),
    "HUMAN_PENDING": frozenset({"HUMAN_ACTIVE", "CLOSED"}),
    # After Handoff there is no return to AI (D-014).
    "HUMAN_ACTIVE": frozenset({"CLOSED"}),
    "CLOSED": frozenset(),
}

_DIALOG_TARGET: dict[DialogTrigger, str] = {
    DialogTrigger.HUMAN_HANDOFF: "HUMAN_PENDING",
    DialogTrigger.OPERATOR_TOOK_OVER: "HUMAN_ACTIVE",
    DialogTrigger.CONVERSATION_CLOSED: "CLOSED",
}


def next_dialog_mode(current: str, trigger: DialogTrigger) -> str:
    target = _DIALOG_TARGET[trigger]
    if target in _DIALOG_ALLOWED[current]:
        return target
    raise TransitionNotAllowed("conversation", current, target)


class SessionTrigger(StrEnum):
    EXPIRED = "EXPIRED"  # worker or lazy read marks it
    ENDED = "ENDED"  # explicit end (e.g. conversation closed)


_SESSION_ALLOWED: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {
    "ACTIVE": frozenset({"EXPIRED", "ENDED"}),
    "EXPIRED": frozenset(),
    "ENDED": frozenset(),
}

_SESSION_TARGET: dict[SessionTrigger, str] = {
    SessionTrigger.EXPIRED: "EXPIRED",
    SessionTrigger.ENDED: "ENDED",
}


def next_session_status(current: str, trigger: SessionTrigger) -> str:
    target = _SESSION_TARGET[trigger]
    if target in _SESSION_ALLOWED[current]:
        return target
    raise TransitionNotAllowed("session", current, target)

import uuid

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.models import User, UserIdentity


class UserRepository:
    async def get_by_identity(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        channel_type: str,
        external_user_id: str,
    ) -> User | None:
        stmt = (
            select(User)
            .join(UserIdentity, UserIdentity.user_id == User.id)
            .where(
                UserIdentity.channel_type == channel_type,
                UserIdentity.external_user_id == external_user_id,
            )
        )
        return (await session.scalars(stmt)).first()

    async def get_or_create_with_identity(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        *,
        channel_type: str,
        external_user_id: str,
        external_user_name: str | None,
    ) -> User:
        """P-06: create user + identity on first sight (race-safe via savepoint)."""
        existing = await self.get_by_identity(session, channel_type, external_user_id)
        if existing is not None:
            return existing

        user = User(display_name=external_user_name or external_user_id)
        identity = UserIdentity(
            user=user,
            channel_type=channel_type,
            external_user_id=external_user_id,
            external_user_name=external_user_name,
        )
        try:
            async with session.begin_nested():
                session.add_all([user, identity])
                await session.flush()
        except IntegrityError:
            # Concurrent first message for the same external user: reuse the winner.
            existing = await self.get_by_identity(session, channel_type, external_user_id)
            if existing is None:
                raise
            return existing
        return user

    async def get(self, session: AsyncSession, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> User | None:
        return await session.get(User, user_id)

"""Conversation and session persistence."""

import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy import select, update
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.models import Conversation, ConversationSession, DialogMode, SessionStatus
from app.domain.exceptions import StateConflict


class ConversationRepository:
    async def create(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        *,
        user_id: uuid.UUID,
        channel_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    ) -> Conversation:
        conversation = Conversation(user_id=user_id, channel_id=channel_id)
        session.add(conversation)
        await session.flush()
        return conversation

    async def get(
        self, session: AsyncSession, conversation_id: uuid.UUID
    ) -> Conversation | None:
        return await session.get(Conversation, conversation_id)

    async def allocate_sequence(
        self, session: AsyncSession, conversation_id: uuid.UUID
    ) -> int:
        """Atomically reserve the next message number (row lock, G-10)."""
        result = await session.execute(
            update(Conversation)
            .where(Conversation.id == conversation_id)
            .values(last_message_sequence=Conversation.last_message_sequence + 1)
            .returning(Conversation.last_message_sequence)
        )
        sequence = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if sequence is None:
            raise StateConflict(f"Conversation {conversation_id} disappeared")
        return int(sequence)

    async def change_mode(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        conversation_id: uuid.UUID,
        *,
        from_mode: DialogMode,
        to_mode: DialogMode,
        expected_state_version: int,
    ) -> int:
        """Optimistic mode change; returns the new state_version (R-05 base)."""
        result = await session.execute(
            update(Conversation)
            .where(
                Conversation.id == conversation_id,
                Conversation.state_version == expected_state_version,
            )
            .values(mode=to_mode, state_version=Conversation.state_version + 1)
            .returning(Conversation.state_version)
        )
        new_version = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if new_version is None:
            raise StateConflict(
                f"Conversation {conversation_id} changed concurrently"
            )
        return int(new_version)


class SessionRepository:
    async def get_active(
        self, session: AsyncSession, conversation_id: uuid.UUID
    ) -> ConversationSession | None:
        stmt = (
            select(ConversationSession)
            .where(
                ConversationSession.conversation_id == conversation_id,
                ConversationSession.status == SessionStatus.ACTIVE,
            )
            .limit(1)
        )
        return (await session.scalars(stmt)).first()

    async def start(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        conversation_id: uuid.UUID,
        *,
        started_at: datetime,
        duration: timedelta,
    ) -> ConversationSession:
        """Insert an ACTIVE session; partial UNIQUE forbids a second ACTIVE one."""
        conversation_session = ConversationSession(
            conversation_id=conversation_id,
            status=SessionStatus.ACTIVE,
            started_at=started_at,
            expires_at=started_at + duration,
        )
        session.add(conversation_session)
        await session.flush()
        return conversation_session

    async def mark(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        conversation_session: ConversationSession,
        status: SessionStatus,
        *,
        at: datetime,
    ) -> ConversationSession:
        conversation_session.status = status
        conversation_session.ended_at = at
        await session.flush()
        return conversation_session

    async def expire_due(self, session: AsyncSession, *, now: datetime) -> int:
        """P-05 worker step: mark every ACTIVE session past its expires_at."""
        result = await session.execute(
            update(ConversationSession)
            .where(
                ConversationSession.status == SessionStatus.ACTIVE,
                ConversationSession.expires_at <= now,
            )
            .values(status=SessionStatus.EXPIRED, ended_at=now)
        )
        return int(result.rowcount or 0)

    async def end_active(
        self, session: AsyncSession, conversation_id: uuid.UUID, *, at: datetime
    ) -> int:
        """Mark all ACTIVE sessions of the dialog ENDED (dialog closed)."""
        result = await session.execute(
            update(ConversationSession)
            .where(
                ConversationSession.conversation_id == conversation_id,
                ConversationSession.status == SessionStatus.ACTIVE,
            )
            .values(status=SessionStatus.ENDED, ended_at=at)
        )
        return int(result.rowcount or 0)

"""Outbox lease/retry and inbound event dedup."""

import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select, update
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import insert as pg_insert
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.models import IntegrationEvent, IntegrationEventStatus, OutboxEvent, OutboxStatus


class OutboxRepository:
    async def register(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        *,
        event_type: str,
        aggregate_type: str,
        aggregate_id: uuid.UUID | None,
        idempotency_key: str,
        payload: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> OutboxEvent:
        """Insert inside the caller's transaction; UNIQUE(idempotency_key) makes
        duplicate registration a no-op."""
        stmt = (
            pg_insert(OutboxEvent)
            .values(
                event_type=event_type,
                aggregate_type=aggregate_type,
                aggregate_id=aggregate_id,
                idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
                payload=payload,
            )
            .on_conflict_do_nothing(index_elements=["idempotency_key"])
            .returning(OutboxEvent)
        )
        result = await session.execute(stmt)
        return result.scalar_one()

    async def lease(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        *,
        batch_size: int,
        lease_seconds: float,
        now: datetime,
    ) -> list[OutboxEvent]:
        """Claim pending rows (SKIP LOCKED): new rows, failed rows past their
        backoff, and rows whose previous lease expired (crash recovery)."""
        stmt = (
            select(OutboxEvent)
            .where(
                OutboxEvent.status.in_([OutboxStatus.NEW, OutboxStatus.PROCESSING]),
                OutboxEvent.next_attempt_at.is_(None)
                | (OutboxEvent.next_attempt_at <= now),
                OutboxEvent.lease_expires_at.is_(None)
                | (OutboxEvent.lease_expires_at <= now),
            )
            .order_by(OutboxEvent.created_at)
            .limit(batch_size)
            .with_for_update(skip_locked=True)
        )
        leased = list((await session.scalars(stmt)).all())
        for event in leased:
            event.status = OutboxStatus.PROCESSING
            event.attempts += 1
            event.lease_expires_at = now + timedelta(seconds=lease_seconds)
        await session.flush()
        return leased

    async def mark_processed(
        self, session: AsyncSession, event_id: uuid.UUID, *, now: datetime
    ) -> None:
        await session.execute(
            update(OutboxEvent)
            .where(OutboxEvent.id == event_id)
            .values(
                status=OutboxStatus.PROCESSED,
                processed_at=now,
                lease_expires_at=None,
                last_error=None,
            )
        )

    async def mark_failed(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        event_id: uuid.UUID,
        *,
        error: str,
        retry_delay_seconds: float,
        now: datetime,
    ) -> None:
        """Release the lease and schedule a retry with backoff."""
        await session.execute(
            update(OutboxEvent)
            .where(OutboxEvent.id == event_id)
            .values(
                status=OutboxStatus.NEW,
                lease_expires_at=None,
                last_error=error,
                next_attempt_at=now + timedelta(seconds=retry_delay_seconds),
            )
        )


class IntegrationEventRepository:
    async def register_if_absent(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        *,
        source: str,
        external_event_id: str,
        payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> IntegrationEvent | None:
        """Webhook idempotency: returns None when the event was seen before."""
        stmt = (
            pg_insert(IntegrationEvent)
            .values(
                source=source,
                external_event_id=external_event_id,
                payload=payload,
                status=IntegrationEventStatus.RECEIVED,
            )
            .on_conflict_do_nothing(
                index_elements=["source", "external_event_id"]
            )
            .returning(IntegrationEvent)
        )
        result = await session.execute(stmt)
        return result.scalar_one()

    async def mark_processed(
        self, session: AsyncSession, event_id: uuid.UUID, *, now: datetime
    ) -> None:
        await session.execute(
            update(IntegrationEvent)
            .where(IntegrationEvent.id == event_id)
            .values(status=IntegrationEventStatus.PROCESSED, processed_at=now)
        )

"""Service layer: business rules and transaction boundaries.

Transaction ownership: methods called by API/worker (top-level operations)
open and commit the transaction via `unit_of_work`; helper methods called by
other services run inside the caller's transaction and never commit.
"""

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession


@asynccontextmanager
async def unit_of_work(session: AsyncSession) -> AsyncIterator[AsyncSession]:
    """Commit on success, rollback on failure. Nesting-safe only at entry points."""
    try:
        yield session
        await session.commit()
    except Exception:
        await session.rollback()
        raise

"""Session lifecycle: fixed 3-hour sessions (D-006/D-007), lazy expiry (P-05)."""

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
import uuid

from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.models import ConversationSession, SessionStatus
from app.repositories.conversations import SessionRepository

# Confirmed rule D-007: a session lasts exactly 3 hours, never configurable.
SESSION_DURATION = timedelta(hours=3)


class SessionService:
    def __init__(self, sessions: SessionRepository | None = None) -> None:
        self._sessions = sessions or SessionRepository()

    async def ensure_active(
        self, session: AsyncSession, conversation_id: uuid.UUID
    ) -> ConversationSession:
        """Return the dialog's usable ACTIVE session, creating one if needed.

        A session whose expires_at has passed is treated as expired on read
        (P-05 lazy guarantee) even before the worker marks it EXPIRED.
        The dialog must not be CLOSED; callers guarantee that (a message after
        CLOSED starts a new dialog, P-04).
        """
        now = datetime.now(UTC)
        active = await self._sessions.get_active(session, conversation_id)
        if active is not None:
            if active.expires_at > now:
                return active
            await self._sessions.mark(
                session, active, SessionStatus.EXPIRED, at=now
            )
        try:
            async with session.begin_nested():
                return await self._sessions.start(
                    session, conversation_id, started_at=now, duration=SESSION_DURATION
                )
        except IntegrityError:
            # Concurrent message in the same dialog created the ACTIVE session.
            winner = await self._sessions.get_active(session, conversation_id)
            if winner is None:
                raise
            return winner

    async def expire_due(self, session: AsyncSession) -> int:
        """P-05 worker step: bulk-mark sessions whose time is up (ACTIVE ->
        EXPIRED is an allowed FSM transition, so the bulk update is safe)."""
        return await self._sessions.expire_due(session, now=datetime.now(UTC))

        new dialog (D-005). Caller's transaction."""

                to_status=TicketStatus.OPEN,
                expected_state_version=last.state_version,

                session,

                action="ticket.reopened",

                entity_id=last.id,

"""Transactional outbox processing: lease -> dispatch -> processed/failed.

Delivery is at-least-once (AGENTS.md §6): a crash after lease re-delivers the
same idempotency_key later; consumers must dedup by that key. The default
handler only logs until stage 5 wires the real bot client.
"""

import logging
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.models import OutboxEvent
from app.repositories.outbox import OutboxRepository
from app.services._tx import unit_of_work

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Exponential backoff: 2s, 4s, 8s... capped.
BACKOFF_BASE_SECONDS = 2.0
BACKOFF_MAX_SECONDS = 300.0
DEFAULT_LEASE_SECONDS = 30.0


def backoff_seconds(attempts: int) -> float:
    """Delay before the next attempt; `attempts` counts the failed tries so far."""
    return min(BACKOFF_BASE_SECONDS * (2 ** max(attempts - 1, 0)), BACKOFF_MAX_SECONDS)


OutboxHandler = Callable[[OutboxEvent], Awaitable[None]]


class LoggingOutboxHandler:
    """Placeholder consumer: proves the pipeline until stage 5 replaces it."""

    async def __call__(self, event: OutboxEvent) -> None:
        logger.info(
            "Outbox event dispatched: type=%s key=%s aggregate=%s/%s",
            event.event_type,
            event.idempotency_key,
            event.aggregate_type,
            event.aggregate_id,
        )


class OutboxService:
    def __init__(
        self,
        repo: OutboxRepository | None = None,
        handler: OutboxHandler | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._repo = repo or OutboxRepository()
        self._handler = handler or LoggingOutboxHandler()

    async def register(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        *,
        event_type: str,
        aggregate_type: str,
        aggregate_id: Any | None,
        idempotency_key: str,
        payload: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> OutboxEvent | None:
        """Register inside the caller's transaction (atomic with the business
        change). Returns None when the idempotency key was already registered."""
        return await self._repo.register(
            session,
            event_type=event_type,
            aggregate_type=aggregate_type,
            aggregate_id=aggregate_id,
            idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
            payload=payload,
        )

    async def process_batch(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        *,
        batch_size: int = 10,
        lease_seconds: float = DEFAULT_LEASE_SECONDS,
        now: datetime | None = None,
    ) -> int:
        """Lease pending events and dispatch them one by one.

        Each event's result is committed in its own transaction; `now` is
        injectable for deterministic backoff/crash-recovery tests.
        """
        current = now or datetime.now(UTC)
        async with unit_of_work(session):
            leased = await self._repo.lease(
                session, batch_size=batch_size, lease_seconds=lease_seconds, now=current
            )

        dispatched = 0
        for event in leased:
            try:
                await self._handler(event)
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.warning(
                    "Outbox dispatch failed: key=%s attempts=%s error=%s",
                    event.idempotency_key,
                    event.attempts,
                    type(exc).__name__,
                )
                async with unit_of_work(session):
                    await self._repo.mark_failed(
                        session,
                        event.id,
                        error=repr(exc),
                        retry_delay_seconds=backoff_seconds(event.attempts),
                        now=current,
                    )
            else:
                async with unit_of_work(session):
                    await self._repo.mark_processed(session, event.id, now=current)
                dispatched += 1
        return dispatched

"""Message flows: ingress (user), AI replies, operator replies.

Rules implemented here (services, not route handlers):
- P-06 (PROPOSED): user auto-provisioning from channel identity;
- P-04 (PROPOSED): routing to the user's latest ticket;
- D-005: one ticket per conversation, messages never split it;
- D-007/D-008: 3-hour sessions, new session on the next message;
- D-010/D-011 and PROPOSED P-14 (G-03): status transitions per event type;
- G-10: sequence_no allocated atomically in the transaction;
- transactional outbox: the message and its event commit together.
"""

import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.domain.state_machines import (
    DialogTrigger,
    TicketTrigger,
    next_dialog_mode,
    next_ticket_status,
)
from app.models import (

    Conversation,
    ConversationSession,
    DialogMode,
    Message,
    MessageAuthorType,
    Ticket,
)
from app.repositories.conversations import ConversationRepository
from app.repositories.messages import MessageRepository
from app.repositories.tickets import TicketRepository
from app.repositories.users import UserRepository
from app.services._tx import unit_of_work
from app.services.audit import AuditService
from app.services.outbox import OutboxService
from app.services.sessions import SessionService
from app.services.tickets import RoutingResult, TicketService


@dataclass
class IngestResult:
    message: Message
    conversation: Conversation
    ticket: Ticket
    session: ConversationSession
    conversation_created: bool
    ticket_reopened: bool
    deduplicated: bool = False


class MessageService:
    def __init__(
        self,
        users: UserRepository | None = None,
        tickets: TicketService | None = None,
        messages: MessageRepository | None = None,
        conversations: ConversationRepository | None = None,
        sessions: SessionService | None = None,
        outbox: OutboxService | None = None,
        audit: AuditService | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._users = users or UserRepository()
        self._ticket_service = tickets or TicketService()
        self._messages = messages or MessageRepository()
        self._conversations = conversations or ConversationRepository()
        self._sessions = sessions or SessionService()
        self._outbox = outbox or OutboxService()
        self._audit = audit or AuditService()

    async def handle_incoming_user_message(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        *,
        channel_type: str,
        external_user_id: str,
        text: str,
        external_user_name: str | None = None,
        external_post_id: str | None = None,
        source_created_at=None,
        channel_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    ) -> IngestResult:
        """Ingress flow for one user message from Tag (via the bot). Own transaction."""
        async with unit_of_work(session):
            if external_post_id is not None:
                existing = await self._messages.get_by_external_post_id(
                    session, external_post_id
                )
                if existing is not None:
                    return await self._rebuild_result(session, existing, deduplicated=True)

            user = await self._users.get_or_create_with_identity(
                session,
                channel_type=channel_type,
                external_user_id=external_user_id,
                external_user_name=external_user_name,
            )
            routing = await self._ticket_service.route_incoming(
                session, user_id=user.id, channel_id=channel_id
            )
            active_session = await self._sessions.ensure_active(
                session, routing.conversation.id
            )
            sequence = await self._conversations.allocate_sequence(
                session, routing.conversation.id
            )
            message = await self._messages.create(
                session,
                conversation_id=routing.conversation.id,
                sequence_no=sequence,
                author_type=MessageAuthorType.USER,
                author_user_id=user.id,
                text=text,
                external_post_id=external_post_id,
                source_created_at=source_created_at,
            )
            await self._apply_ticket_transition(session, routing)
            await self._outbox.register(
                session,
                event_type="message.user_received",
                aggregate_type="message",
                aggregate_id=message.id,
                idempotency_key=f"message:{message.id}",
                payload={
                    "message_id": str(message.id),
                    "conversation_id": str(routing.conversation.id),
                },
            )
            await self._audit.log(
                session,
                actor_type=AuditActorType.USER,
                action="message.created",
                entity_type="message",
                entity_id=message.id,
                actor_id=user.id,
                details={
                    "conversation_id": str(routing.conversation.id),
                    "sequence_no": sequence,
                },
            )
            return IngestResult(
                message=message,
                conversation=routing.conversation,
                ticket=routing.ticket,
                session=active_session,
                conversation_created=routing.conversation_created,
                ticket_reopened=routing.ticket_reopened,
            )

    async def add_ai_reply(
        self,

        *,

        text: str,

        PROPOSED P-14 (G-03): the first AI reply moves NEW -> OPEN.
        Own transaction.

                next_dialog_mode(str(conversation.mode), DialogTrigger.HUMAN_HANDOFF)
            ticket = await self._require_ticket_by_conversation(session, conversation_id)
            sequence = await self._conversations.allocate_sequence(session, conversation_id)
            message = await self._messages.create(
                session,
                conversation_id=conversation_id,
                sequence_no=sequence,
                author_type=MessageAuthorType.AI,
                text=text,
            )
            # FSM: AI_REPLY is only valid from NEW/OPEN (P-14).
            target = TicketStatus(next_ticket_status(str(ticket.status), TicketTrigger.AI_REPLY))
            if target != ticket.status:
                await self._transition_ticket(session, ticket, target)
            await self._register_outbound(session, message, conversation_id)
            await self._audit.log(
                session,
                actor_type=AuditActorType.AI,
                action="message.created",
                entity_type="message",
                entity_id=message.id,

            )
            return self._result(message, conversation, ticket)

    async def add_operator_reply(
        self,

        *,
        ticket_id: uuid.UUID,
        text: str,
        operator_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
        reply_to_message_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    ) -> IngestResult:

- P-06 (PROPOSED): user auto-provisioning from channel identity;
- P-04 (PROPOSED): routing to the user's latest ticket;
- D-005: one ticket per conversation, messages never split it;
- D-007/D-008: 3-hour sessions, new session on the next message;
- D-010/D-011 and PROPOSED P-14 (G-03): status transitions per event type;
- G-10: sequence_no allocated atomically in the transaction;

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

    message: Message

    ticket: Ticket
    # Filled for ingress results; replies do not touch sessions.
    session: ConversationSession | None

    ticket_reopened: bool

        messages: MessageRepository | None = None,
        conversations: ConversationRepository | None = None,
        sessions: SessionService | None = None,
        outbox: OutboxService | None = None,
        audit: AuditService | None = None,
        ticket_repo: TicketRepository | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._users = users or UserRepository()
        self._ticket_service = ticket_service or TicketService()
        self._messages = messages or MessageRepository()
        self._conversations = conversations or ConversationRepository()
        self._sessions = sessions or SessionService()
        self._outbox = outbox or OutboxService()
        self._audit = audit or AuditService()

    async def handle_incoming_user_message(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        *,
        channel_type: str,
        external_user_id: str,
        text: str,
        external_user_name: str | None = None,
        external_post_id: str | None = None,
        source_created_at: datetime | None = None,
        channel_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    ) -> IngestResult:
        """Ingress flow for one user message from Tag (via the bot). Own transaction."""
        async with unit_of_work(session):
            if external_post_id is not None:
                existing = await self._messages.get_by_external_post_id(
                    session, external_post_id
                )
                if existing is not None:
                    return await self._rebuild_result(
                        session, existing, deduplicated=True
                    )

            user = await self._users.get_or_create_with_identity(
                session,
                channel_type=channel_type,
                external_user_id=external_user_id,
                external_user_name=external_user_name,
            )
            routing = await self._ticket_service.route_incoming(
                session, user_id=user.id, channel_id=channel_id
            )
            active_session = await self._sessions.ensure_active(
                session, routing.conversation.id
            )
            sequence = await self._conversations.allocate_sequence(
                session, routing.conversation.id
            )
            message = await self._messages.create(
                session,
                conversation_id=routing.conversation.id,
                sequence_no=sequence,
                author_type=MessageAuthorType.USER,
                author_user_id=user.id,
                text=text,
                external_post_id=external_post_id,
                source_created_at=source_created_at,
            )
            await self._apply_ticket_transition(session, routing)
            await self._outbox.register(
                session,
                event_type="message.user_received",
                aggregate_type="message",
                aggregate_id=message.id,
                idempotency_key=f"message:{message.id}",
                payload={

                    "conversation_id": str(routing.conversation.id),
                },
            )
            await self._audit.log(

                actor_type=AuditActorType.USER,
                action="message.created",
                entity_type="message",
                entity_id=message.id,
                actor_id=user.id,
                details={

                    "sequence_no": sequence,
                },
            )

                message=message,
                conversation=routing.conversation,
                ticket=routing.ticket,
                session=active_session,

                ticket_reopened=routing.ticket_reopened,

"""ARQ worker tasks.

Tasks accept an optional `session_factory` in the arq context so tests can
inject a test-DB factory; production builds one from the app settings.
"""

import logging
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker, create_async_engine

from app.config import get_settings
from app.services.outbox import OutboxService
from app.services.sessions import SessionService

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_FACTORY_KEY = "session_factory"


def _session_factory(ctx: dict[str, Any]) -> async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession]:
    factory = ctx.get(_FACTORY_KEY)
    if factory is not None:
        return factory
    engine = create_async_engine(get_settings().database_url, pool_pre_ping=True)
    return async_sessionmaker(engine, expire_on_commit=False)


async def process_outbox(ctx: dict[str, Any], batch_size: int = 10) -> int:
    """Lease and dispatch pending outbox events (at-least-once)."""
    factory = _session_factory(ctx)
    async with factory() as session:
        dispatched = await OutboxService().process_batch(
            session, batch_size=batch_size
        )
    if dispatched:
        logger.info("Outbox batch dispatched: %s", dispatched)
    return dispatched


async def expire_sessions(ctx: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
    """P-05: mark sessions whose 3 hours are over (does NOT touch tickets)."""
    factory = _session_factory(ctx)
    async with factory() as session:
        expired = await SessionService().expire_due(session)
        await session.commit()
    if expired:
        logger.info("Sessions expired: %s", expired)
    return expired

from typing import Any

from arq import cron
from arq.connections import RedisSettings

from app.config import get_settings

    return RedisSettings.from_dsn(settings.redis_url)


class WorkerSettings:
    functions = [process_outbox, expire_sessions]
    redis_settings = _redis_settings()

    # Session expiry runs every minute; expiry is idempotent (P-05).
    cron_jobs = [cron(expire_sessions, minute=set(range(60)), run_at_startup=False)]

    on_shutdown: Any = None
    max_jobs = 10

    ("PENDING_USER", TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_REPLY, "PENDING_USER"),

    # User message -> OPEN (docs/01 §3; D-010 reopen from RESOLVED).
    ("OPEN", TicketTrigger.USER_MESSAGE, "OPEN"),
    ("PENDING_USER", TicketTrigger.USER_MESSAGE, "OPEN"),
    ("RESOLVED", TicketTrigger.USER_MESSAGE, "OPEN"),
    # Operator resolve (docs/01 §3).
    ("NEW", TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_RESOLVED, "RESOLVED"),
    ("OPEN", TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_RESOLVED, "RESOLVED"),
    ("PENDING_USER", TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_RESOLVED, "RESOLVED"),
    # Operator close: decides himself, no auto-close (docs/01 §3).
    ("NEW", TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_CLOSED, "CLOSED"),
    ("OPEN", TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_CLOSED, "CLOSED"),
    ("PENDING_USER", TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_CLOSED, "CLOSED"),
    ("RESOLVED", TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_CLOSED, "CLOSED"),
]

FORBIDDEN_TICKET = [
    # PROPOSED P-14: user's own message keeps NEW (G-03 - until owner decides).
    ("NEW", TicketTrigger.USER_MESSAGE),
    # AI never answers human-mode or resolved tickets.
    ("PENDING_USER", TicketTrigger.AI_REPLY),
    ("RESOLVED", TicketTrigger.AI_REPLY),
    ("CLOSED", TicketTrigger.AI_REPLY),
    # Resolve is not repeatable; close/resolve/replies impossible after CLOSED.
    ("RESOLVED", TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_RESOLVED),
    ("CLOSED", TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_RESOLVED),
    ("CLOSED", TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_REPLY),
    ("CLOSED", TicketTrigger.USER_MESSAGE),
    ("CLOSED", TicketTrigger.OPERATOR_CLOSED),
]

ALLOWED_DIALOG = [
    ("AI_ACTIVE", DialogTrigger.HUMAN_HANDOFF, "HUMAN_PENDING"),
    ("AI_ACTIVE", DialogTrigger.OPERATOR_TOOK_OVER, "HUMAN_ACTIVE"),
    ("AI_ACTIVE", DialogTrigger.CONVERSATION_CLOSED, "CLOSED"),
    ("HUMAN_PENDING", DialogTrigger.OPERATOR_TOOK_OVER, "HUMAN_ACTIVE"),
    ("HUMAN_PENDING", DialogTrigger.CONVERSATION_CLOSED, "CLOSED"),
    ("HUMAN_ACTIVE", DialogTrigger.CONVERSATION_CLOSED, "CLOSED"),
]

FORBIDDEN_DIALOG = [
    # No return to AI after Handoff (D-014); no handoff request in human modes.
    ("HUMAN_ACTIVE", DialogTrigger.HUMAN_HANDOFF),
    ("HUMAN_PENDING", DialogTrigger.HUMAN_HANDOFF),
    ("HUMAN_ACTIVE", DialogTrigger.OPERATOR_TOOK_OVER),
    ("CLOSED", DialogTrigger.HUMAN_HANDOFF),
    ("CLOSED", DialogTrigger.OPERATOR_TOOK_OVER),
    ("CLOSED", DialogTrigger.CONVERSATION_CLOSED),
]

ALLOWED_SESSION = [
    ("ACTIVE", SessionTrigger.EXPIRED, "EXPIRED"),
    ("ACTIVE", SessionTrigger.ENDED, "ENDED"),
]

FORBIDDEN_SESSION = [
    ("EXPIRED", SessionTrigger.EXPIRED),
    ("EXPIRED", SessionTrigger.ENDED),
    ("ENDED", SessionTrigger.EXPIRED),
    ("ENDED", SessionTrigger.ENDED),
]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("current", "trigger", "expected"), ALLOWED_TICKET)
def test_ticket_allowed(current: str, trigger: TicketTrigger, expected: str) -> None:
    assert next_ticket_status(current, trigger) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("current", "trigger"), FORBIDDEN_TICKET)
def test_ticket_forbidden(current: str, trigger: TicketTrigger) -> None:

def test_dialog_forbidden(current: str, trigger: DialogTrigger) -> None:

"""Outbox tests on real PostgreSQL: idempotency, lease, retry, crash recovery."""

import asyncio
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

import pytest
from sqlalchemy import func, select

from app.models import Message, MessageAuthorType, OutboxEvent, OutboxStatus
from app.repositories.messages import MessageRepository
from app.repositories.outbox import IntegrationEventRepository, OutboxRepository
from app.services._tx import unit_of_work
from app.services.messages import MessageService
from app.services.outbox import OutboxService


def _key(n: int) -> str: return f"evt-{n}"


async def _seed(session_factory, n: int, prefix="evt") -> list[str]: 
    keys = []
    async with session_factory() as session:
        repo = OutboxRepository()
        for i in range(n):
            k = f"{prefix}-{i}"
            await repo.register(session, event_type="test.event", aggregate_type="test", aggregate_id=None, idempotency_key=k, payload={"i": i})
            keys.append(k)
        await session.commit()
    return keys


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_register_is_idempotent_by_key(session_factory):
    repo = OutboxRepository()
    async with session_factory() as session:
        first = await repo.register(session, event_type="t", aggregate_type="a", aggregate_id=None, idempotency_key="k1", payload={})
        duplicate = await repo.register(session, event_type="t", aggregate_type="a", aggregate_id=None, idempotency_key="k1", payload={})
        await session.commit()
    assert first is not None and duplicate is None


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_concurrent_leases_are_disjoint(session_factory):
    await _seed(session_factory, 6, "lease")
    repos = OutboxRepository()

    async def lease(session) -> set[str]:
        events = await repos.lease(session, batch_size=10, lease_seconds=30, now=datetime.now(UTC))
        await session.commit()
        return {e.idempotency_key for e in events}

    async with session_factory() as s1, session_factory() as s2:
        keys1, keys2 = await asyncio.gather(lease(s1), lease(s2))

    assert keys1 and keys2
    assert keys1.isdisjoint(keys2)
    assert keys1 | keys2 == {f"lease-{i}" for i in range(6)}
